goal: Haiku Battle League is a place where people can submit their best diss haiku for head-to-head battles. Users judge by selecting the best haiku between two randomly selected submissions. Include leaderboards, daily/weekly winners, and daily aggregated point totals. Design for 5-10M daily users with scalable storage, caching, and async job processing. Ship an MVP with a clear growth path, including backend APIs, frontend UX, and deployment guidance.
